title: Momentum sprint 1:1 scratch - Noor Ali - Mar 21 2026
agenda: Quick stand-in (5m) -> Outcomes from last 2 weeks (10m) -> Current sprint health + metrics (10m) -> Blockers and support (10m) -> Career / growth sync (10m) -> One experiment to try (5m) -> Action items and close (5m).
context: This is a lightweight prep for my weekly 1:1 with Arjun (IC, infra). He moved from on-call focus to a cross-team opt-in feature this sprint; I want to make sure workload is sustainable, recognize recent reliability work, and clarify what success looks like for the feature launch. Use this as a scratchpad — I expect to capture live notes and follow-ups here.
metrics: On-call MTTR trend: down 14% last 2 weeks (pager reduction after automation). Deployment cadence: 3 deploys/week for service X. Feature progress: 60% of integration tests passing; CI flakiness at ~18%. PR backlog: 4 open >72h. Time spent on support: ~40% of week (self reported).
talking_points: 1) Celebrate the MTTR drop and dig into what specifically reduced it (who owned the automation, doc updates). 2) Confirm scope for the opt-in feature: what is MVP vs stretch? 3) Ask about CI flakiness root cause hypotheses and next steps. 4) Capacity and bandwidth forecast for next 2 sprints (is help needed?). 5) Psychological safety check — any async pressure from downstream teams?
praise_and_positive_feedback: Call out Arjun for the reliability play: his runbook edits and the small automation script shaved several minutes off incident resolution. Mention I noticed his async updates in #infra-status and they helped reduce redundant pages. Reinforce that delegation of oncall runbook responsibility was the right trade-off.
blockers_and_support_needed:
- CI flakiness (test timeout noise) -> Offer pairing time with QA or schedule a focused 2-hr triage with SRE.
- Capacity: ask whether a short-term intern/contractor would help or whether we can deprioritize a non-critical task.
- Cross-team alignment: a few unclear ownership edges with Product; propose a short alignment doc and a 30m sync with PM.
career_growth_notes: Arjun mentioned interest in leading a small reliability initiative and mentoring a junior engineer. Explore a concrete 3-month leadership experiment: run a mini postmortem program and own one recruiting interview loop. Discuss what support/visibility he needs — maybe a 1:1 skip-level intro to the Head of SRE.
one_change_experiment: Try a single 'two-hour focus block' two times this week: block calendar, no notifications, and pair with a QA engineer for flakiness triage. Measure if this reduces context switches and moves the flakiness ticket forward. Revisit in next 1:1.
action_items:
- Arjun: identify top 3 flaky tests and annotate JIRA-8721 by Fri 2026-03-26.
- Noor (me): schedule 90m troubleshooting block with QA + SRE (by Tue 2026-03-23).
- Both: draft a 1-page ownership alignment doc for feature handoff (by Wed 2026-03-24).
- Noor: propose contractor requisition template to Eng Ops if capacity problem persists (by next weekly planning).
closing_notes_and_next_1on1: End with a quick temperature check: 1-5 workload + 1-5 confidence in shipping. Confirm next 1:1 time and whether live pairing is useful mid-week. I want to end by asking: 'What's one thing I can do before our next 1:1 to make your life easier?'
raw_notes: Warm opener ideas: ask about weekend hike, quick kudos to Priya for triaging last incident. Watch for guarded language about bandwidth ('fine' vs concrete hours). If Arjun asks for more ownership, prep a small laddered plan: observe -> lead -> own. Favorite example to share: how Sophia ran a postmortem program (link to CONFLUENCE-ENG-4567). Potential followups: sync with Product on ownership (PM: Lina), runbook review session, and candidate to pair for hiring loop. Live capture: incident timeline, proposed mitigations, and any new cross-team asks.
format_notes: This doc is a private scratchpad — I'll paste action items into the shared 1:1 tracker after the meeting and create JIRA child tasks as needed. Keep an eye on the PR numbers in github.com/redwood-inference/rw-infra to update the PR backlog count.
